itinerary.title: Day 1 — Sapa
description: Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi. After a warm welcome and breakfast, board your private luxury vehicle for a scenic drive to the mountainous region of Sapa (approx. 5-6 hours). Arrive at Sapa Jade Hill and check in. Enjoy a relaxed evening and a gourmet Indian vegetarian welcome dinner.
activities: VIP Airport Fast-track, private airport transfer to Sapa, Indian vegetarian welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 2 — Sapa
description: Embark on a guided trekking tour to Cat Cat village, learning about the Black Hmong culture and viewing the scenic waterfall. Savor a local vegetarian lunch. Spend a relaxed afternoon exploring Sapa town or enjoying the resort's facilities. Overnight at Sapa Jade Hill.
activities: Sapa tour with guide and entry tickets, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 3 — Sapa
description: A highlights day in Sapa! Take the Fansipan cable car, the longest three-rope cable car system in the world, to ascend the 'Roof of Indochina' at 3,143 meters. Explore the spiritual pagoda complex at the summit. Enjoy a scenic vegetarian lunch. In the afternoon, visit Ta Van village. Overnight at Sapa Jade Hill.
activities: Fansipan cable car roundtrip tickets, guide, Sapa transfers, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 4 — Hanoi
description: Enjoy a free day to relax at Sapa Jade Hill, shop for souvenirs in Sapa town, or explore at your own pace. In the late afternoon, transfer to Lao Cai station. Board the Chapa Express Train for your overnight journey back to Hanoi in pre-arranged private 4-berth cabins.
activities: Station transfer, Chapa Express Train tickets.

itinerary.title: Day 5 — Hanoi
description: Arrive at Hanoi station early in the morning and transfer to Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa for a hot breakfast and early check-in (subject to availability). Enjoy a full-day city tour of Hanoi, visiting the historic Temple of Literature, Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum complex, and Hoan Kiem Lake. Savor a vegetarian dinner in the Old Quarter.
activities: Station transfer, Hanoi full-day tour with guide and entry tickets, vegetarian lunch & dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 6 — Ninh Binh
description: Embark on a full-day private excursion to Ninh Binh. Experience the serene beauty of Trang An landscape complex, a UNESCO World Heritage site, during a traditional rowboat tour through limestone caves. Visit the ancient capital of Hoa Lu and climb to the peak of Mua Cave for panoramic views over the rice fields. Return to Hanoi in the late...
activities: Private roundtrip vehicle to Ninh Binh, English guide, Trang An boat tour, Mua Cave entry, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 7 — Halong Bay
description: Depart Hanoi by private vehicle to Halong Bay. Board the premium Ambassador Signature Cruise, where your Double and Triple cabins await. Glide past iconic karst formations and enjoy a delicious vegetarian buffet lunch on board. Participate in cruise activities including a bamboo boat ride or kayaking.
activities: Private transfer Hanoi - Halong, double & triple cabins on Ambassador Signature Cruise, cruise excursions, onboard vegetarian lunch and...

itinerary.title: Day 8 — Hanoi
description: Greet the sunrise with Tai Chi on the sundeck. After a vegetarian brunch, check out and disembark. Transfer back to Noi Bai International Airport by private luxury vehicle for your international departure flight.
activities: Onboard vegetarian brunch, private transfer Halong - Hanoi Airport.

hotels.name: Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa
hotels.introduction: Located in the scenic mist-covered hills of Sapa, Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa features stunning panoramic views of Fansipan mountain and Muong Hoa valley. Designed with local heritage details, the hotel offers comfortable heated bungalows, an outdoor pool, and local gourmet dining.

hotels.name: Chapa Express Train
hotels.introduction: Chapa Express Train offers premium overnight sleeper service between Hanoi and Lao Cai (Sapa). Featuring traditional wooden panels, comfortable air-conditioned cabins, clean amenities, and personalized passenger hospitality.

hotels.name: Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa
hotels.introduction: Nestled in the historic Ba Dinh district, Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa blends French colonial charm with modern hospitality. It offers elegant rooms, a rooftop bar with spectacular city views, and a serene spa for a perfect urban retreat.

hotels.name: Ambassador Signature Cruise
hotels.introduction: A premier 5-star overnight cruise sailing through the mystical waters of Halong Bay and Lan Ha Bay. The cruise features elegant cabins with private balconies, upscale dining, an outdoor jacuzzi, and immersive itineraries showcasing natural wonders.

room_notes: Double + Triple room configurations pre-arranged across all properties. For the overnight train, 2 private 4-berth cabins have been fully booked for 5 guests to ensure complete comfort.
